views.title: Architecture — blast radius
views.summary: Everything this change touches, across all three lanes.

views.title: What was retired
views.summary: The single-send path, kept visible so a reviewer can confirm nothing else called it.

walkthrough.heading: sendBroadcastBulk and buildBulkPayload added
walkthrough.body: Nothing loops over recipients any more. The sender works on a whole batch at a time.

walkthrough.heading: getSuppressedEmails added before the send
walkthrough.body: It pulls the blocked addresses once, before any batch is built.

walkthrough.heading: processBroadcast and sendSingleEmail removed
walkthrough.body: sendBroadcastBulk does their job for whole batches.

walkthrough.heading: The send sequence gained 6 new steps
walkthrough.body: The queue write is the only step that was there before, and it now stamps the batch size.

walkthrough.heading: Postmark now gets 500 emails per call
walkthrough.body: One call per batch, and Postmark answers with a result for each message.

walkthrough.heading: 4 parts added, 2 removed, across 3 lanes
walkthrough.body: A 2,000-person broadcast used to make 2,000 calls to Postmark. It now makes 4.
